category: Identify and Confirm Vulnerabilities on an Ongoing Basis (RV)
subcategory_text: Confirm the applicability and impact of each reported vulnerability to the organisation's software, and triage by severity, exploitability, and exposure.
implementation_examples: Triage vulnerabilities using CVSS, EPSS, and contextual exposure scoring
Reproduce the vulnerability in a test environment before remediation
Document triage decisions in the vulnerability-management system
assessment_objectives: Determine whether vulnerabilities are confirmed and triaged.
Determine whether triage considers severity and actual exposure.
